answer: An AI-agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring each identity to prove continuous observation of a rare walnut-wood artifact whose unique grain pattern is verified against a comet-like light trajectory only visible in a hollow chamber at specific times. This physical binding makes mass identity creation costly because an attacker must obtain and maintain distinct walnut pieces, synchronize their comet observations, and house them in separate hollow spaces that cannot be virtually shared or cheaply replicated at scale.
